listing.name: Vagrant Story (Vagrant Story Recompiled)
listing.summary: A hybrid Vagrant Story port: its ROM-free Windows player reads your own USA SLUS-01040 PlayStation disc, then compiles battle, menu and title code in the background with bundled GCC. An interpreter/TinyCC handles remaining code, so full-game native coverage is unconfirmed. The separate MSVC source build is a development route. The project manages generated code and caches. Other player platforms, exact accepted revision/hashes and BIOS/firmware requirements are unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
